# Jayashanka Anushan

> Jayashanka Anushan is an automation-focused Robotics Engineer and MSc Robotics researcher (Middlesex University Dubai) based in Dubai, UAE, working on ROS2, humanoid robotics, human-robot interaction (HRI), embedded systems and cloud robotics. He is the founder of RoboJain, a robotics engineering studio in Dubai, and the author of CARA, a low-cost assistive robot for elderly care built as his MSc thesis.

This site has three parts:

- **Portfolio** (`/`): professional profile, skills, experience, research interests, GitHub projects, videos and contact details.
- **CARA** (`/CARA/`): full documentation and weekly research journal of CARA (Companion Assistive Robot for the Aged), an MSc Robotics thesis project at Middlesex University Dubai, 2026.
- **RoboJain** (`/robojain/`): Jayashanka's robotics engineering studio in Dubai, UAE. It builds DIY-to-medium-scale robotic systems, embedded engineering and automation for real-world conditions, with RJ-Life software products and RJ-Robot hardware products.

Key facts:

- Name: Jayashanka Anushan
- Role: Robotics Engineer & MSc Researcher; founder of RoboJain
- Location: Dubai, UAE
- Education: Middlesex University (MSc Robotics, Dubai); London Metropolitan University
- Research focus: assistive robotics for elderly care, humanoid robot perception, multimodal emotion recognition, robot vision and sensor fusion, auditory perception, cloud robotics (AWS + ROSBridge)
- Contact: jayasankaanushan199@gmail.com · RoboJain: robojain.robotics@gmail.com

## CARA — Companion Assistive Robot for the Aged

CARA is a low-cost, GSM-based companion assistive robot for elderly care in developing countries. It pairs an NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano (MediaPipe pose estimation and a trained RandomForestClassifier for AI fall detection) with an Arduino Mega 2560 for real-time motor control and obstacle avoidance. It alerts registered family members by GSM/LTE SMS with no Wi-Fi dependency.

- [CARA overview](https://jayashankaanushan19.github.io/CARA/): Project home and summary.
- [About](https://jayashankaanushan19.github.io/CARA/about.html): Background, motivation and context of the MSc Robotics thesis.
- [Objectives](https://jayashankaanushan19.github.io/CARA/objectives.html): Research objectives and research questions.
- [Architecture](https://jayashankaanushan19.github.io/CARA/architecture.html): ROS node graph, 5-state machine and communication protocols.
- [Hardware](https://jayashankaanushan19.github.io/CARA/hardware.html): Full bill of materials, specifications and cost breakdown.
- [Features](https://jayashankaanushan19.github.io/CARA/features.html): The 15 integrated features across priority tiers.
- [Research](https://jayashankaanushan19.github.io/CARA/research.html): Literature review covering ageing demographics, assistive robots, fall detection, GSM alerting and the research gap.
- [Documentation](https://jayashankaanushan19.github.io/CARA/docs.html): Functional and non-functional requirements, safety design and system specifications.
- [Timeline](https://jayashankaanushan19.github.io/CARA/timeline.html): Gantt chart of the real build.
- [Development blog](https://jayashankaanushan19.github.io/CARA/blog/): Weekly build logs (Weeks 01–16), implementation notes and lessons learned.
- [Appendices](https://jayashankaanushan19.github.io/CARA/appendix/): Wiring diagram, firmware listing, fall detection node, ethics approval, raw test results and AI usage statement.
- [Gallery](https://jayashankaanushan19.github.io/CARA/gallery.html): System diagrams, circuit schematics and build photos.
- [Contact](https://jayashankaanushan19.github.io/CARA/contact.html): Contact the CARA researcher.
